information: ## Welcome to the Miri City 20th Anniversary STEM Cube Open 2025! [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/Miri20thAnnSTEMCubeOpen2025) **If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Updates & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Miri20thSTEMCubeOpen2025#56395-updates-announcements) and the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Miri20thSTEMCubeOpen2025#56396-new-competitors) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.** Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
